_what: A grade for EVERY finding the briefs raise, not only the ones eval/cases.json asks for. correct = a real issue Karandeep should see, at a fair severity; partly = real issue but the severity, wording or number is off; duplicate = the same issue already raised by another finding; noise = true but not worth his time (the answer key treats it as acceptable / market standard); wrong = not supported by the contract or its own quote. severity: ok | too_high | too_low.
_by: Drafted by Claude (13 Oct 2026) against docs/Eval_Set.md, the contracts and Karandeep's checklist; to be confirmed by Karandeep. Labels follow the deal and finding key, so they carry over to regenerated briefs; a finding with no label is reported as ungraded by npm run eval.
